name: 棋绮后（黑子）
evolution: 棋棋（黑子） Lv.26 → 棋绮后（黑子） → 棋契陛下
description: “黄金时代崩解后不知多久，黑子开始失眠。它们不再在日出时准点沉睡，而是继续在废土上继续巡逻。没有族人可守，它们便去围着倒塌的遗迹转圈，被认为是一种刻板行为。”——《黄金时代的地系工匠们·十三》
descriptionEn: Some time after the collapse of the Golden Age, the black pieces began to suffer insomnia. They no longer sleep on schedule at sunrise, but keep patrolling the wasteland. With no kin to guard, they circle the collapsed ruins, considered a stereotypic behavior. — 'The Earth Craftsmen of the Golden Age · XIII'
